title: Chain.Love MCP
description: Hosted MCP gateway for Web3 infra discovery across 20+ networks via one endpoint.
summary: Hosted MCP gateway for Web3 infra discovery across 20+ networks via one endpoint.
offersHint: Hosted MCP gateway for Web3 infra discovery across 20+ networks via one endpoint. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://app.chain.love/mcp · Optional headers: x-chainlove-cred-github

headers.name: x-chainlove-cred-github
headers.description: Optional session-scoped credential example for downstream MCP access. This example uses GitHub: send your raw GitHub token in x-chainlove-cred-github. Other downstream MCP credentials can be passed similarly using x-chainlove-cred-<credential_key>.

headerDocs.name: x-chainlove-cred-github
headerDocs.description: Optional session-scoped credential example for downstream MCP access. This example uses GitHub: send your raw GitHub token in x-chainlove-cred-github. Other downstream MCP credentials can be passed similarly using x-chainlove-cred-<credential_key>.

toolsPreview.name: discover_networks
toolsPreview.description: List authoritative chain/network keys available in the current release. Call this first to choose a valid chain before discover_categories or search.

toolsPreview.name: discover_categories
toolsPreview.description: For a chosen chain, list its dynamic categories and compact category summaries. Call this after discover_networks and before search when you want deterministic retrieval.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search Chain.Love registry services. Prefer passing explicit chain/category from discover_networks and discover_categories, but standalone search still works without prior discovery.

toolsPreview.name: bind_credentials_bag
toolsPreview.description: Optionally bind session-scoped downstream credentials immediately after initialize. Safe to call even when no credentials are available.

toolsPreview.name: execute
toolsPreview.description: Unified execution entrypoint for registry actions, saved connection management, downstream MCP connection validation, and downstream MCP runtime actions
